name: Guam A.B. Won Pat International Airport

hours.quote: 2.3.1 All Months, All Days, All Hours

notes: Read the FAA US AIP Part 3 AD 2 Guam page (HTML; no edition or effective date shown on the page). It gives no curfew, PPR or slot rule for PGUM and no customs hours. The airport authority's Guam Customs page lists only a 24-hour duty supervisor phone line, which does not confirm 24-hour clearance. Guam has its own customs (Guam Customs and Quarantine Agency) as well as US CBP immigration: confirm the clearance times with the handler. The FAA Chart Supplement Pacific could not be found as a current official PDF.
